title: 第5章 这一世！夺回一切！
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
事实证明，铁锅炼丹效果还是非常不错的。

    李应灵犹如鲸吞一般开始吸纳灵力，开始准备突破筑基。

    楚星尘连忙从空间戒指中拿出几枚灵石，迅速摆成简单聚灵阵，来保证李应灵突破时灵气足够。

    那本水心经楚星尘也研究过了，虽然看上去确实有些花眼。

    但不愧是帝君出品，人家是按照完美筑基的路子写的心法。

    毕竟根基不稳怎能成仙？

    唯有体内混元饱满，神台清灵，才能水到渠成的筑基。

    作为上等仙苗，修炼进度虽然快，但是基础还是夯实的。

    毕竟是自楚星尘收的第一个徒弟，又怎么会真的不上心。

    看着李应灵气息逐渐内敛。

    楚星尘就明白这次稳了。

    半个时辰后，系统的提示声就来了。

    【大弟子李应灵已突破筑基期】

    【奖励发放】

    【神通：三千弱水剑】

    【发布正式任务：招收合格弟子达到两名】

    【奖励：聚灵法阵】

    【正式任务二：招收合格弟子达到三名】

    【奖励：真武大殿】

    主线任务倒还算在意料之内。

    只不过，这徒弟哪里那么好找啊。

    楚星尘不由幽幽的叹了口气。

    调息完成睁开眼的李应灵正满心欢喜，打算说些什么，就看见楚星尘眼神空洞的看向自己，随后叹了一口气。

    ？？？

    自己修炼是劈叉了？李应灵连忙扫视过体内情况，却发现正常无比。

    那是怎么了？自己筑基方式不对？！

    可仔细观察好几次，却什么问题也没发现！完啦！这就是最严重的问题了。

    李应灵弱弱道：“师……师父，我是不是要完了？”

    回过神来，楚星尘莫名奇妙的看了一眼李应灵：

    “你在说什么乱七八糟的话。”

    楚星尘将那一本神通从系统空间里取了出来，丢给了李应灵。

    “这是神通，是修士最后底牌，好好练。”

    接过飞来的神通，李应灵看了一眼封面，干净整洁，封面上三千弱水剑写的十分有韵味。

    李应灵小心翼翼的打开，和想象中被改了几个版本不同。

    这本神通干干净净，就连字都写的飘逸好看。

    这看上去倒有点像路边摊上淘的野鸡神通了。
content_en:
Facts have proved that the effect of making alchemy in an iron pot is very good.

Li Yingling began to absorb spiritual power like a whale swallowing it, and began to prepare to break through the foundation.

Chu Xingchen quickly took out a few spirit stones from the space ring and quickly formed a simple spirit gathering array to ensure that Li Yingling had enough spiritual energy when he broke through.

Chu Xingchen also studied the Water Heart Sutra, although it did look a bit dazzling.

But it is worthy of being produced by Dijun, and it was written according to the method of perfect foundation building.

After all, how can one become an immortal if his foundation is not stable?

Only when the Hunyuan in the body is full and the altar is clear, can the foundation be successfully established.

As a top-grade immortal seedling, although the cultivation progress is fast, the foundation is still solid.

After all, he was the first disciple he accepted from Chu Xingchen, so how could he really not care about him?

Watching Li Yingling's aura gradually become more restrained.

Chu Xingchen knew that this time it was safe.

Half an hour later, the system prompt came.

[Big disciple Li Yingling has broken through the foundation building stage]

【Reward Distribution】

[Supernatural Power: Three Thousand Weak Water Swords]

[Released official task: Recruit two qualified disciples]

[Reward: Spirit Gathering Array]

[Official Task 2: Recruit three qualified disciples]

[Reward: Zhenwu Hall]

The main mission is fairly predictable.

It's just that this apprentice is so easy to find.

Chu Xingchen couldn't help but sigh quietly.

Li Yingling, who had finished adjusting his breath and opened his eyes, was filled with joy and was about to say something when he saw Chu Xingchen looking at him with empty eyes, and then sighed.

???

Is it true that I am doing the splits when I am practicing?Li Yingling quickly scanned the condition inside his body and found that it was extremely normal.

What happened?Is the way you build your own foundation wrong?!

But after careful observation several times, I found no problems!It’s over!This is the most serious problem.

Li Yingling said weakly: "Master...Master, am I going to die?"

After coming back to his senses, Chu Xingchen glanced at Li Yingling inexplicably:

"What nonsense are you talking about."

Chu Xingchen took out the magical power from the system space and threw it to Li Yingling.

"This is magical power, the monk's last trump card. Practice it well."

After receiving the flying magic power, Li Yingling took a look at the cover. It was clean and tidy, and the words "Three Thousand Weak Water Swords" on the cover were very charming.

Li Yingling opened it carefully, and it was different from what he imagined as it had been changed several times.

This magical book is clean, even the writing is elegant and beautiful.

This looks a bit like the pheasant magic found at a roadside stall.
